axes.name: Legal-effect class
axes.values: The ten ratified constitutional taxonomy classes, class-01 through class-10
axes.note: An author-chosen planning grammar, not derived and not exhaustive; preserved as its own axis and never reused as the domain axis.

axes.name: Social domain
axes.values: The twelve-cluster minimum inventory, FS-DOM-01 through FS-DOM-12
axes.note: Answers which part of life is involved and where its decisions belong; orthogonal to the legal-effect class.

axes.name: Layer (scope disposition)
axes.values: The five ratified routing dispositions, stored under the scope_disposition key
axes.note: One enum, one key. These five values are the reader-facing five-layer society map, author-ratified 2026-08-09. A leaf record carries exactly one; a domain record spans all five as its buckets.

axes.name: Claim posture
axes.values: Derived, Checked, Evidenced, Specified, Reasoned, Unestablished
axes.note: One posture per claim record; a record that would carry two is two records.

axes.name: Assurance route
axes.values: The seven ratified routes, FS-RTE-01 through FS-RTE-07
axes.note: A route establishes what it executes, over what it was given, and nothing further; one green route never stands in for another.

axes.name: Assurance overlay
axes.note: A liveness claim is never established today; a feasibility claim may not appear in Book 1 at all.

axes.name: Defect disposition
axes.values: The closed seven-value enum; the last three are explicit non-resolution boundaries
axes.note: Answers what the design did about a known failure; orthogonal to posture, route, overlay, class, and domain.

axes.name: Response stage
axes.note: Route-relative, not a universal total order; a stage supplies no assurance by itself.

scope_disposition_meanings.constitutional-invariant: The condition is guaranteed or refused by the constitution itself; no tier, majority, emergency, or remedy may lower it.
scope_disposition_meanings.democratic-ordinary-law-choice: A decision left to ordinary majorities inside the ratified corridor; the constitution bounds it without choosing it.
scope_disposition_meanings.protected-private-civic-freedom: A protected private or civic choice; an explicit non-prescription or non-interference disposition counts as coverage and authorises no rule, record, operator, or success certification.
scope_disposition_meanings.book-2-operation: Owned by Book 2: staffing, costs, capacity, resources, technology, workflows, transition, deployment, and operation under ordinary and declared shock conditions.
scope_disposition_meanings.external-assumption: A premise outside both books: named, owned, falsifiable, and never laundered into an established claim.

gate_applicability_meanings.gate-a: versioned scope map and assurance test program
gate_applicability_meanings.gate-d: Book 2 operational model in a calibrated envelope

routing_marker_meanings.not-constitutionally-prescribed: The bucket is deliberately empty of constitutional content; the absence is the disposition, checked for rights harm, concentrated power, public duty, and commons effects.
routing_marker_meanings.democratic-ordinary-law-choice: The bucket's content is chosen by ordinary law inside the corridor.
routing_marker_meanings.book-2-operation: The bucket's content is routed to Book 2 as operation.
routing_marker_meanings.external-assumption: The bucket's content rests on a named external premise.

posture_meanings.Derived: An executable engine result over the exact current source, or over a named bounded mutation declared in a fixture or reviewed audit.
posture_meanings.Checked: A mechanical check establishing a property of the artifacts, never of the world and never a semantic impossibility.
posture_meanings.Evidenced: A claim about the world with population, period, place, and method.
posture_meanings.Specified: A complete contract, stated but not formalised; carries an explicit unimplemented marker.
posture_meanings.Reasoned: Argument against a named adversarial corpus; permanently weaker than Derived and never citable as it.
posture_meanings.Unestablished: Not established; carries exactly one named disposition.

unestablished_disposition_meanings.routed-book-2: Routed to Book 2; routing is a disposition, not assurance.
unestablished_disposition_meanings.external-assumption: Rests on a named external premise with owner and falsifier.
unestablished_disposition_meanings.route-unbuilt: Its only route is neither built nor available; carries severity, consequence, owner, closure condition, and a public-claim restriction.
unestablished_disposition_meanings.evidence-pending: Its route is built or available, but no admitted evidence currently establishes the claim; any valid failure remains recorded as failure and is never rewritten as not run.
unestablished_disposition_meanings.author-ruling-pending: Waits for a named author ruling; briefs may proceed, dependent work may not.
unestablished_disposition_meanings.refused: Deliberately refused by a standing ruling.
unestablished_disposition_meanings.not-establishable: No route could establish it as stated; the claim must narrow or stay unmade.

evidence_kind_meanings.executable: The pin suites and the record, temporal, amendment, placement, and counterfactual runs; the only kind that warrants Derived.
evidence_kind_meanings.pattern-guard: A guard that reads spelling or structure; a pattern guard is not a proof.
evidence_kind_meanings.freshness: A generator --check mode or staleness gate; currency, not truth.
evidence_kind_meanings.inventory: A reviewed operation set, record class, or scenario narrative; a reviewed threat model, explicitly not executable proof.

overlay_meanings.safety: May be Derived with a supplied-records scope bound and an enumerated non-extension clause.
overlay_meanings.liveness: Arrival, advance, action, release, delivery, repair; never Derived, Checked, or Reasoned; Unestablished until operational assurance exists.
overlay_meanings.feasibility: Needs models or simulations plus operational assurance; may not be written in Book 1 at all.
overlay_meanings.none: The claim asserts routing, structure, or method rather than a safety, liveness, or feasibility property.

route_status_meanings.built: Its check exists and runs in verify.sh.
route_status_meanings.available: Its evidence contract, admissibility criteria, named reviewer, and in-repo gate exist so outside evidence can be admitted.
route_status_meanings.unbuilt: Neither built nor available; naming a route does not build it.

defect_disposition_meanings.eliminated-structurally: The failure-producing route no longer exists in the declared model; the repaired source must refuse the former result for the intended reason.
defect_disposition_meanings.prevented: The initiating failure cannot arise within the named scope.
defect_disposition_meanings.protected-consequence-contained: The initiating failure may arise, but the named protected consequence cannot cross the stated boundary.
defect_disposition_meanings.remedied: After harm occurs, an evidenced route restores the protected condition; never proves prevention.
defect_disposition_meanings.externally-bounded-assumption: Closure depends on a premise outside the model; explicitly bounded is still not internally resolved.
defect_disposition_meanings.irreducible-limitation: The chosen model cannot close the failure without contradicting a settled boundary; honest limitation is not resolution.

response_stage_meanings.detected: The failure has a visible, attributable witness; nothing is yet specified, implemented, prevented, repaired, recovered, or resolved.
response_stage_meanings.interface-specified: Book 1 assigns a duty, evidence, continuity, challenge, or remedy interface, but no implemented route establishes its effect.
response_stage_meanings.implemented-in-assigned-route: The response exists in its assigned route; the stage supplies no assurance.
response_stage_meanings.operationally-assured-in-envelope: A staffed, costed, accountable route is exercised end to end in the named test setting; supports only the reproducible operational-design claim for that envelope.

resolution_status_meanings.resolved-for-claim: Generated only: the affected claim's ceiling, disposition, stage, route, and evidence jointly permit resolution for that claim alone.
resolution_status_meanings.unresolved-for-claim: Generated only: the default; detected, specified, assigned, implemented, disclosed, and understood are not synonyms for resolved.

proposal_disposition_meanings.added: The proposal entered the canonical source as records.
proposal_disposition_meanings.classified-out: Classified with reasons under the ratified dispositions or as duplicate or immaterial, carrying the matching Unestablished disposition.
proposal_disposition_meanings.retained-limit: Retained as an unresolved severity-rated limit with owner and closure condition.

envelope_status_meanings.stub: The permanent pre-envelope identity: records keyed before the envelope was versioned cite it; it can route, never assure.
envelope_status_meanings.versioned-structure: Fields, definitions, dependents, and invariance statements are versioned and reviewable; no value exists. This satisfies Gate A's envelope precondition, while operational assurance and remedied resolution still require calibration.
envelope_status_meanings.calibrated: Values calibrated and validated by Book 2 at Gate D. Refused outright in this contract: calibration becomes legal only through a deliberate future contract amendment.

value_status_meanings.declared-pending: The field is declared without a value; calibration is Book 2's Gate D work, and no value enters Book 1.

lawful_source_meanings.constitutional-minimum-or-ceiling: The threshold's content is fixed by the constitution itself; democratic law may exceed it, never lower it.
lawful_source_meanings.democratic-policy-target: Democratic law chooses the level inside the corridor; the constitution bounds without choosing.
lawful_source_meanings.scientific-safety-boundary: An independently reviewed scientific process supplies the evidence boundary; science supplies evidence, not law.
lawful_source_meanings.operational-diagnostic: An operational measurement or adjudicated finding owned by Book 2 or an authorised external process; it diagnoses, it does not legislate.

role_kind_meanings.life-course: A stage or transition of a human life the constitution must reach — birth to death — never a capacity grade.
role_kind_meanings.care-and-dependency: A relation of giving, receiving, or supporting care; each party keeps separate standing and a separate floor.
role_kind_meanings.learning-and-culture: A position in learning, creation, belief, or the voluntary sphere; protected, never certified or ranked.
role_kind_meanings.economic: A position in work, property, exchange, or economic power; none gates the floor and labels never decide status.
role_kind_meanings.civic-political: A position in democratic choice, office, service, or civic action; one person, one equal ballot.
role_kind_meanings.membership-and-mobility: A position in residence, membership, movement, or collective belonging; presence, not paperwork, is the test.
role_kind_meanings.justice-and-coercion: A position in accusation, injury, holding, custody, or release; the prisoner is the stress test, not the default inhabitant.
role_kind_meanings.cross-cutting: A position every domain can reach — the record subject, the animal custodian — routed once, not duplicated per domain.

scale_meanings.individual: One person's own rights, choices, and remedies.
scale_meanings.household-association: Voluntary living, pooling, and associational arrangements; membership never merges standing.
scale_meanings.local: The local tier's protected competences and services.
scale_meanings.regional: The regional tier's residual authority under subsidiarity.
scale_meanings.national: The common tier's enumerated competences and guarantees.
scale_meanings.cross-jurisdictional: Movement, portability, effective control, extradition, and external relations.
scale_meanings.intergenerational: The inherited ecological capability and option-space; protected without a present-person record.

power_position_meanings.affected: The role stands under the power's decisions and bears its failure.
power_position_meanings.checking: The role holds a standing route to contest, oversee, or replace the power.

role_anchor_meanings.constitution-predicate-derived: The role's marker is a derived-only conclusion in the current constitution; nothing can write it directly.
role_anchor_meanings.constitution-predicate-asserted: The role's marker is a writable admitted relation in the current constitution; the record prose carries its replace-card path where one is ratified.
role_anchor_meanings.ratified-doctrine-unimplemented: The role rests on an author-ratified ruling not yet formalised; no predicate, rule, or remedy exists in the engine.

flow_kind_meanings.authority: Lawful mandate, delegation, command, and confidence; power moves only through its source.
flow_kind_meanings.information: Records, evidence, reasons, disclosure, and attestation; a record is routing, never proof of the world.
flow_kind_meanings.care: Care given, received, and supported; each party keeps a separate floor.
flow_kind_meanings.labour: Work sustaining functions across every ownership form; status follows reality, not labels.
flow_kind_meanings.resources: Physical and ecological inputs and capacities; scarcity is a finding, never a budget choice.
flow_kind_meanings.money: Funding, payment, and fiscal transfer; payment is never delivery.
flow_kind_meanings.claims: Initiation, challenge, relief, and remedy; a claim costs nothing and risks nothing.
flow_kind_meanings.services: Provision and operation of what people use; a promise is not an arrival.
flow_kind_meanings.accountability: Examination, oversight, review, and correction; the examiner never creates the facts it certifies.

dependency_class_meanings.constitutionally-guaranteed: The flow exists by ratified invariant and survives ordinary politics; the class names the lawful source of the obligation, never a delivery status.
dependency_class_meanings.democratically-selected: The flow is supplied by an election, confidence, enactment, budget, or mandate inside the corridor.
dependency_class_meanings.operationally-supplied: The flow rides on Book 2 operating machinery or actual private operation that does not exist yet; no body is functional because its name exists.
dependency_class_meanings.externally-assumed: The flow rests on a named external assumption; nothing internal manufactures it.

loop_kind_meanings.service: An ordinary provision-and-correction circle acting on each step's output.
loop_kind_meanings.feedback: An oversight, electoral, or review circle returning consequences to their source.
loop_kind_meanings.fiscal: The revenue, appropriation, and provision circle; deadlock mints nothing.
loop_kind_meanings.ecological: The delivery-and-regeneration circle under the two-sided bound.
loop_kind_meanings.sequence: A staged circle that unwinds in time — a sequence, not a deadlock.

lifecycle_path_meanings.right: The ratified right path: duty, accessible delivery, receipt evidence, failure, continuity, remedy, audit, correction.
lifecycle_path_meanings.power: The ratified power path: lawful trigger, bounded act, public reasons, independent review, appeal, correction or end.
lifecycle_path_meanings.record: The ratified record path: authorised basis, limited visibility, challenge, correction, assurance of the correction path.
lifecycle_path_meanings.outside-ratified-paths: The edge serves a function outside the three ratified person-facing paths; its routing fields still carry interruption, continuity, remedy, restoration, and correction.

scenario_kind_meanings.journey: An ordinary-success path through a domain: who acts, what must arrive, and what the person can do when it does not; success is the floor and the liberty holding, never a state-defined life outcome.
scenario_kind_meanings.stress: A failure or abuse path: what must not happen, what breaks first, and which recorded route catches it.
scenario_kind_meanings.collision: Two ratified goods meeting on one named axis; the record states the invariant that survives the collision, never a winner by count.
scenario_kind_meanings.compound-shock: A named whole-society shock crossing many domains at once; Book 1 states invariant and failure behaviour, and capacity and degradation stay Book 2's tests.

collision_axis_meanings.property-vs-floor: Lawful property, tenure, and credit meeting the unconditional floor; no holding or debt extinguishes another person's floor claim.
collision_axis_meanings.speech-association-vs-private-harm: Protected expression and association meeting evidenced private harm; conduct crosses the line, a label alone does not.
collision_axis_meanings.majority-vs-minority: Democratic choice meeting the corridor; no margin makes a floor-cutting or discriminatory policy lawful.
collision_axis_meanings.parent-guardian-power-vs-child-standing: Fiduciary adult power meeting the child's independent standing and growing decision-specific authority.
collision_axis_meanings.employer-landlord-platform-power-vs-mean: Concentrated private power meeting the person's real ability to leave; unavailable exit controls the transaction.
collision_axis_meanings.emergency-vs-liberty: Declared hazard powers meeting personal liberty; restriction is hazard-specific and reviewable, and its legal effect ends absent current source-bound evidence.
collision_axis_meanings.present-allocation-vs-future-commons: Present allocation meeting the inherited ecological option-space; ceilings bound the choice and a breach stays a breach.
collision_axis_meanings.locality-vs-portability: Protected local variation meeting the person's portable floor and standing; no tier lowers the common minimum.
collision_axis_meanings.privacy-vs-public-accountability: Transparency aimed at power meeting privacy owed to persons; aggregates open audit while person-level identity stays walled.
collision_axis_meanings.physical-scarcity-vs-equal-floor: Genuine physical shortage meeting equal floor claims; rationing mitigates recorded failure and never re-ranks human worth.

shock_kind_meanings.pandemic: Disease-driven declared restrictions and scarce care together; rights survive, the forbidden priority keys stay forbidden, and capacity is Book 2's test.
shock_kind_meanings.famine: Food scarcity against the equal floor; the finding is contestable, a ration is never renamed the minimum, and production is Book 2's.
shock_kind_meanings.infrastructure-failure: Records, payments, or utilities stop; duties survive their instruments, and restoring operation is Book 2 work.
shock_kind_meanings.displacement: Mass movement across borders and regions; presence within effective control carries the floor, and reception capacity is Book 2's.
shock_kind_meanings.institutional-capture: Connected offices under one controlling interest; the design reduces and exposes capture and never claims it impossible.
shock_kind_meanings.conflicting-jurisdictions: Two authorities claim one person or power; the last uncontested holder keeps it while the Court decides.

protected_sphere_form_meanings.freedom-without-permission: The protected act needs no licence, registration, or approval to be lawful.
protected_sphere_form_meanings.non-recording-non-compulsion: No record is made and no participation is compelled; absence of a record is not a gap.
protected_sphere_form_meanings.evidenced-harm-threshold: State attention begins only at the narrow, evidenced-harm threshold, never at disapproval.
protected_sphere_form_meanings.recourse-against-interference: Interference below the threshold is itself the wrong, with a recorded challenge route.

Resolves only the named failure in its exact model.
Route-appropriate hostile and negative controls test the initiation boundary. Resolves only the initiating-failure claim.
Bypass, composition, and negative-control cases test the exact stated boundary. Resolves only the named consequence and boundary.

Requires an Evidenced liveness claim through operational assurance, recording actor, trigger, interim continuity, restoration, challenge, recurrence control, and evidence. Resolves only the recovery claim and never proves prevention.
Name the source or authenticator, falsifier, failure consequence, owner, and public-claim restriction. Explicitly bounded is still not internally resolved.
Supply the argument, alternatives considered, residual risk, and exact claim narrowing. Honest limitation is not resolution.
Carry severity, consequence, owner, closure condition, affected claims, and blocking gate. A critical unresolved defect blocks its affected claim.

domains.title: Personhood and life course
domains.applicability: every person within jurisdiction or effective control, from birth through death
domains.status: seeded-stage-1; routing complete at domain grain
domains.severity: critical if left open — every other domain hangs from standing
domains.consequence: an unrouted personhood question would let a record gate a person
domains.closure_condition: contract cards complete for standing, adulthood, and life-course rule families

constitutional_invariants.answer: Universal standing: every person counts before any other rule applies; personhood roots the floor, survives witnessed record replacement, and no tier, emergency, or remedy may remove it. A born child is an independent rights-holder; general adulthood arises automatically at one common-tier statutory age; plenary guardianship and status-based incapacity are refused.

ordinary_law_choices.answer: Common-tier law chooses the single numeric adulthood age and life-course programme design inside the ratified limits; neither ruling supplies the number.

protected_private_civic.answer: Identity, self-description, and intimate life-course choices are protected from prescription, outcome certification, and social scoring.

book2_operations.answer: Registration and vital-records administration, care and family proceedings, clinical and death-record operations, staffing, costs, and workflows.

external_assumptions_note.answer: Witness production, outside record arrival, and successor production are named external assumptions (FS-EXA-02, FS-EXA-03).

scenario_applicability.answer: Life-course journeys from first contact through birth, adulthood, ageing, and succession, with dependency and standing collisions, exercise this domain's ordinary, failure, and recovery interfaces; execution is sequenced behind the relevant author rulings and contract cards.

domains.reader_destination: Chapters on evidence, standing, and the vote; the family and life-course chapters arrive with their rule families.

ordinary_law_choices.answer: Medically assisted dying is democratically permissible, neither guaranteed nor prohibited; compensation regulation for gestational agreements; care-programme design above the floor.

constitutional_invariants.answer: The learning and expression floor items; teaching plus hearing derives learning without ranking the learner; recognition for teaching is unconditional and never ranked; minority culture, language, education, and media protections; internal cultural selection bounded by universal rights.

ordinary_law_choices.answer: Curriculum, institutions, subsidy, and cultural programme design above the floor; statutory knowledge exclusivity remains time-bounded and must yield through a compatible access route chosen by democratic law.

stopping_rule.materiality_test: A proposal is material when accepting it could change a declared right, liberty, power, duty, protected private boundary, cross-domain dependency, ordinary-life account, failure/recovery path, or adequacy, accessibility/equality, continuity, resilience, sustainability, safety, or resource criterion.
stopping_rule.boundary: Exhaustive may describe the disposition map only for the named axes above, a named source version, a named envelope, and a named review event. This is versioned exhaustiveness for those declared axes, not a timeless completeness theorem, and disclosure alone does not cure a critical gap.
stopping_rule.no_hiding_rule: No critical unresolved defect affecting a gate's permitted claim may be hidden by classification, assignment, disclosure, or a stopping-rule decision.

severity_rubric.critical: Accepting the proposal would falsify the gate's permitted claim — a scope or assurance omission. An unresolved critical item blocks the affected gate even when it has an owner or has been disclosed, and a checked post-closure critical classification reopens Gate A.
severity_rubric.material: Material under the ratified materiality test, without falsifying the gate's permitted claim. A material item receives a severity owner, an independent check, and one public disposition; retention as a limit creates or joins a stable defect row.
severity_rubric.minor: The editorial band: no record change and no materiality under the test. Recorded reasons suffice; no severity machinery attaches.

criteria.name: Adequacy
criteria.definition: A floor condition counts as delivered only on independent recipient-side evidence of timely, accessible, adequate real access; a payment that cannot procure the good is not delivery.
provenance: the former Book 1 envelope tracker bullet

criteria.name: Accessibility / equality
criteria.definition: Access is a proactive, systemic duty read against the responsible institution as a whole, with an effective alternative and public continuity route wherever a provider cannot serve.
provenance: the former Book 1 envelope tracker bullet (equity and accessibility)

criteria.name: Continuity
criteria.definition: Public continuity is immediate and non-delegable when a private arrangement fails, is refused, or is exited; withdrawal, dispute, inaccessibility, inadequacy, or failure activates it.
provenance: the former Book 1 envelope tracker bullet

criteria.name: Resilience
criteria.definition: Under every shock member the design states what continues, what narrows, who may decide, who is protected first, what cannot be suspended, how review arrives, and how ordinary authority is restored — and no right, institution, election, or remedy is suspended.
provenance: the former Book 1 envelope tracker bullet

criteria.name: Sustainability
criteria.definition: Protected ecological axes are non-substitutable and may not be collapsed into one sustainability, productivity, or social-value score; ceilings are democratic law inside an independently reviewed scientific envelope.
provenance: the former Book 1 envelope tracker bullet

criteria.name: Resource
criteria.definition: Genuine physical scarcity preserves each person's equal constitutional minimum wherever supply allows and records every unmet portion as failure under the forbidden priority keys; budget choice and artificial withholding are never scarcity.

criteria.name: Safety
criteria.definition: Force is strictly necessary, least harmful, minimum, warned where feasible, stopped on achievement, and followed by aid, with the burden of lawfulness on the public actor and the categorical refusals absolute.
provenance: the boundary decision's materiality test — the seventh member, carried so no ratified criterion is dropped

functional_criteria.drift_note: The criteria list appears in five ratified variants: the mandate names adequacy, equality/accessibility, continuity, resilience, sustainability, and resource; the former Book 1 envelope tracker bullet names adequacy, continuity, equity, accessibility, resilience, and sustainability without resource; the boundary decision's materiality test adds safety; the book-2 mirror compounds them as accessibility/equity, continuity/reserve, recovery/resilience, ecological-sustainability, and fiscal/resource-feasibility; and the ledger's former threshold deferral named five, omitting sustainability. This canon is the union with provenance — no criterion any ratified text names is dropped — and the ledger's own materiality test is aligned in the same change to the boundary decision's exact wording.
